method: Unchanged original akr/ant/alw run against a minimal World test double (SetBlock, scheduled-tick list with a HashSet and 1000 ticks per tick, neighbour notification in x-1,x+1,y-1,y+1,z-1,z+1 order). Per tick: a 31x+char hash of the block-and-level grid; at the end: BlockLiquid.getFlowVector and getFlowDirection of every water cell. The double carries the world Random (ahb.s, seeded per scenario), WorldProvider.hasNoSky/isHellWorld (aqo.f/g) and records ahb.a(x,y,z,sound,volume,pitch) calls; each scenario also records every sound and the Random's next int after the last tick. Scenarios named nether-* run with both provider flags set.
